figurative_meaning_en: To show one's mood or temper
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে হঠাৎ রঙ দেখাতে শুরু করল যখন তার কথা শুনল না।
মিটিংয়ে বস বিরক্ত হয়ে রঙ দেখালেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He suddenly showed his temper when no one listened to him.
The boss displayed his mood in the meeting out of irritation.
note: The idiom implies revealing one's disposition, often negatively, without gaining any advantage from it.
